role: React hook that formats elapsed time from a start timestamp, updating the display every second.
detail: useSessionTimer is a custom React hook that accepts a startTimestamp (number) and returns a formatted elapsed-time string. It uses useState to track the elapsed display string (initial: "0:00") and a useEffect with a 1000ms interval to recalculate elapsed time. On each tick, it computes total seconds via (Date.now() - startTimestamp) / 1000, then derives hours/minutes/seconds; if hours > 0, format is h:mm:ss, otherwise m:ss. The interval is cleaned up on unmount or when startTimestamp changes (dependency array includes startTimestamp).
gotchas: No error handling if startTimestamp is invalid (negative, future, NaN); no memo/useMemo on the formatting logic, so the string is recreated on every interval tick even if the formatted output is identical to the previous tick.
